title: Who will win the PFA Men's Players' Player of the Year award for the 2025–26 season?
background: The Professional Footballers’ Association (PFA) presents annual awards recognizing outstanding players in English professional football, with winners selected by fellow players.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The PFA’s official announcement of its Men's Players' Player of the Year award for the 2025–26 season, or reliable news reporting of that announcement. 
  Resolution : Resolve when the winner is publicly announced. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The winning player's full name.
